ops.oldText: without regard for its conflict of laws provisions.
ops.newText: without regard for its conflict of laws provisions. The parties submit to the exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts located in New York County, New York for all disputes arising out of or related to this Agreement.

input.comment: [Playbook] New York law is acceptable to us, but the clause is silent on forum, so we have added exclusive jurisdiction in the state and federal courts in New York County to match the governing law and avoid disputes over venue. We can accept Delaware, California, or London courts as a fallback.
input.summary: Add exclusive New York County court venue to the New York choice-of-law clause.
